note: Rhythm test on Sonnet. Every condition keeps the plain-prose line so that it is compared with the stored plain_prose samples and with the human reference, which is running prose. voice_spec uses the test voice specification from BRIEF.md word for word.

rhythm_content.template:
{prompt}

Write it as plain prose with no headings or lists. Let the length of each sentence follow what it has to say. Do not use a short sentence to set up a longer one.

rhythm_medium.template:
{prompt}

Write it as plain prose with no headings or lists. Write mostly medium-length, complete sentences.
